Posted 'Cloud City Leia's Quarters' dested Cloud City: Guest Quarters (the Light Cloud City site where Leia stayed).

Posted 'Elyk Rhue' dested Elyhek Rue; 'Wedge, Rogue Squadron Leader' dested Wedge Antilles, Red Squadron Leader; 'Blue 5' dested Blue Squadron 5; 'Out Of Commission / TransTerm' dested Out Of Commission & Transmission Terminated; 'Xwing Laser Cannon' dested X-wing Laser Cannon.
The list as posted totals 57; the strategy says two Run Luke, Run! and The Bith Shuffle & Desperate Reach were left off and are in the deck, so they are added (60).

The strategy says this was the poster's (and co-poster Steebo's) Massachusetts State Championship deck, a version of Alex Klammrodt ('avatar')'s deck, which lost only to Hayes Hunter's deck (played by Steebo Baroni) and a Dark Side sac deck. Posted by 'Deck and Steebo'.
